text: you hear coughing. People here cough more than they breathe. See, most peasant houses had an
open fire burning inside the same room people slept in. There was often no chimney, or a very
poor one, so the smoke didn't leave. Day after day, year after year, people breathed it in from
childhood. Everyone smells terrible. Imagine a mixture of wet dog, sweaty armpit, rotten
milk, and burned wood. And this is before anyone starts working. And before you even stand up fully,
your stomach already complains. You're hungry. Good news. Breakfast exists. Bad news. Breakfast
exists. You stumble to the kitchen, which is just the same room, and breakfast is waiting
for you. It's a wooden bowl full of...potage. What is potage? Imagine a stew that has been
boiling since your great-great-grandfather was alive. Every day, they don't make a new stew.
